toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"snake_openai-gpt-5.6-terra_01.html","edit_description":"Create this new single-file, polished Snake game. Use HTML/CSS/vanilla JavaScript only. Build a responsive dark arcade UI containing a start-menu overlay with selectable buttons for exactly three modes: Human vs Human, CPU vs Human, and CPU vs CPU. Playfield is a canvas rendering an exact 30x30 grid with two colored snakes, individual foods, a compact scoreboard, and clear in-game instruction legend. On game start, run continuous movement via a timed game loop. Snake 1 must use Arrow keys and Snake 2 must use WASD. CPU snakes should automatically choose safe movement toward their own food using a simple direction scoring/path-seeking heuristic that avoids walls, themselves, and the other snake; avoid immediate reverse moves. Eating food grows a snake, increments that snake's score, and relocates food to an empty cell. Collision with walls, itself, or the other snake ends the game and shows a game-over overlay announcing winner/draw and final scores. Press R, Enter, or Space from game over to restart the selected mode; Escape returns to menu. Include pause functionality with P, a pause overlay/status, accessible button labels, canvas aria label, and prevent arrow-key scrolling. Make visual quality high: vibrant cyan/magenta contrast, cards, glow, responsive canvas sizing, header, instructions. Do not use external libraries or assets."}
